name: AddClimaxes
description: Count climaxes of the speaking NPC that the player tells as part of the story, not an in-game scene (those are counted already). Silent: never mention the count or that anything is counted.
note: Needs OSL Aroused, Mantella Living World - Arousal and Mantella's Advanced Actions on (tool calling). Adds to the NPC's climax count toward being satisfied. Only offered to the player's lovers, an open group off duty, or NPCs the player allowed intimacy with (the Hub's hotkey); a friend alone is not enough.

count.description: How many: the player's number, else an estimate.

prompt: If the player describes you climaxing a number of times in the story, begin your response with '{key}:'
